description: This Java class, ReadAsset, is an Android Activity that loads a text file from the app assets and displays its contents in a TextView. It reads the asset 'read_asset.txt', converts the byte data to a String, and sets it into a TextView with id 'text'.

classes.name: ReadAsset
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating reading an asset file and displaying its contents.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the asset file, and displays its contents in a TextView.
